label: Bible Study
prompt: The _____ is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verse: The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
note: David's reminder of who holds the deed — Paul quotes it in 1 Corinthians 10 over a question about meat.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Yet I will _____ in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
verse: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
note: No figs, no fruit, no flocks in the verse before — and still Habakkuk says 'Yet I will rejoice.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been _____: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
verse: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
note: Saul's sight returned when something like scales fell from his eyes — the source of the English idiom.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And _____ your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
verse: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
note: Tearing your robe was the classic grief gesture; Joel says God wants the heart torn instead — the clothes can stay.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Not forsaking the _____ of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
verse: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
note: Not forsaking 'the assembling of ourselves together' — the verse every pastor quotes about Sunday attendance.
